_doc: Curated wallpapers. file = image name without extension (webp, jpg, jpeg or png sits next to this file). versions = exact ids ("1.21.4"), prefix patterns ("1.20.*", "26.3*") or inclusive ranges ("1.21.6-1.21.8"). When several entries match a version, one is picked by the hash of the instance id. generic = true (only without versions) puts the entry into the pool used when no version rule matches; an entry with versions is never generic. scrim = overlay strength 0.3-0.9 (default 0.6; less for very dark images). Entries whose image is missing are skipped.
